output_list.reason: Only the PreSale Contract have the right to mint token.
Only team can unfreeze the token transfer.
Transfer should be disabled when the contract is frozen.
Approve should be disabled when the contract is frozen.

The mint function only have the PreSale contract as the caller and is used to mint token for the PreSale. The only possible exploits is: the PreSale contract has a bug that cause incorrect token amount to be minted, or the token minting is not necessary for the ICO. The correct fix for this vulnerability is, remove the mint function.
